title.narrative: Synchronizing Teaching with the New Curriculum - Education Ethiopia

description.narrative:
The project is a follow-up/phase 2 on the Norway supported ETH-20/0003 “Curriculum Reform Technical Assistance to Ministry of Education in Ethiopia”. The Ministry of Education revised and developed a new curriculum for the primary level and secondary level, which was respectively introduced in September of 2022 and September of 2023. The Norway supported program ended mid-year 2023.
As the curriculum has been introduced, the issue of training of teachers to familiarise themselves and understand the new curriculum are still outstanding. Hence, the need to focus on teacher development and teacher’s methodology in a bid to make sure that the new curriculum results in better learning outcomes for learners and further continued transition from grade to grade all the way to higher education/TVET is adamant.
The overall objective of this project is to ensure orientation and training of pre-primary and primary school teachers on the newly rolled out curriculum and initiate the development and implementation of a comprehensive teacher’s professional development programme encompassing pre-service and in-service.
Professional development offerings are key for supporting teachers in the new curriculum initiative. The benefit includes teachers’ increased comfort and skill levels for implementing the new curricula. Holistic, relevant, and effective professional development promotes confidence and greater understanding of the curriculum including the expected learning outcomes. Meaningful teachers’ professional development considers the needs, concerns, and experiences of the teachers and is likely to influence growth for teachers. It also enhances teachers’ pedagogical skills and content knowledge, which leads to increased job satisfaction and professional motivation ultimately shown in children’s learning outcomes.
